fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting criticizing the Miami Salvation Army as a "charity" racket, using the case of blind itinerant Ira Corwin and police assistance as an example; commentary on Florida Power & Light and Gov. Fuller Warren’s interest in reviving the state Improvement Commission and potential public acquisition of utility properties; discussion of national health insurance proposals associated with President Truman and Sen. Claude Pepper; and a lengthy reprinted/attributed report alleging major patent medicine and drug firms subsidize propaganda lobbying against national health legislation and have faced FTC actions for misleading advertising. Also contains local court/police blotter-style column and commentary on racetrack gambling and touts (including references to Hialeah Park and a "Crime Commission").
